description: This is a shell script file that contains a series of tests for Git checkout operations, including branch switching, creating new branches, handling unmergeable changes, and various checkout options.

methods.name: do_checkout
methods.description: Performs a 'git checkout' with various parameters, checking if it succeeds or fails as expected, and verifying the resulting branch and commit state.

methods.name: test_dirty_unmergeable
methods.description: Checks that git diff returns an exit code indicating unmergeable changes.

methods.name: test_dirty_unmergeable_discards_changes
methods.description: Checks that running 'git diff' discards changes on unmergeable files.

methods.name: setup_dirty_unmergeable
methods.description: Sets up a repository state with unmergeable changes.

methods.name: test_dirty_mergeable
methods.description: Checks that 'git diff --cached' returns a non-zero exit code if there are mergeable changes staged.

methods.name: test_dirty_mergeable_discards_changes
methods.description: Checks that staged mergeable changes are discarded properly.

methods.name: setup_dirty_mergeable
methods.description: Prepares the repository with mergeable changes staged for testing.
